name: 33054 · Opa Locka, FL
findings: ZIP 33054 (Opa Locka) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (18%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33054 (Opa Locka) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33054 (Opa Locka) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
